claims.statement: Signed 64-bit and 32-bit wrap models are identities on their represented signed ranges.
The parsed checkpoint branches equal the independent checkpoint contract for every modeled state and observation.
For a valid countdown, the parsed sampling method equals its contract, the source initializer is 1024, each earlier timed call decrements, and a due call observes the clock.
For a valid state, parsed charge equals the independent charge contract; a successful active charge admits its entire nonnegative cost and subtracts exactly that cost.
Sample and charge preserve the declared remaining-fuel and countdown invariant.
An admitted batch length satisfies the existing Work.boundedFold complete-batch contract.
An exhausted active checkpoint remains exhausted; a timed active checkpoint rejects an observation at or beyond its limit.

productionBridges.statement: All production charge sites cover every algorithmic operation and allocation.
Whole Java program, setup/allocation helpers, parser/native solver and exception/lifecycle behavior refine Lean.
Python scheduling/HTTP, browser/IIS/Cloudflare and provider transport refine the proof models.
Wall-clock completion, CPU/RSS bounds and arbitrary future executions satisfy an absolute end-to-end deadline.
Every broader AP01 production bridge remains unclosed; this finite proof does not promote the historical implementation ledger.

trusted.description: Underlying processor and memory correctly execute the checker.
The restricted Java lexer/parser, field/state interpretation and lowering to Lean are trusted translation machinery; unknown syntax is rejected and mutations are mechanically challenged.
Normal Java compiler/JVM primitive semantics and same-thread ThreadLocal identity are trusted; clock observations are explicit inputs, not axioms or guarantees about wall time.
Installed pinned Lean 4.34.1 kernel/compiler and standard library; actual per-declaration axiom dependencies must be a subset of the three explicitly registered imported Lean foundations.

Exactly the imported Lean foundations propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound may occur in audited declaration dependency inventories. No project axiom declaration, sorry, native proof escape or additional axiom is allowed.
Linux process/filesystem semantics, network namespace enforcement and tool invocation.
Pinned Python executable and its standard-library execution semantics.
The orchestrator reports actual reviewer model identities; six bound review records are advisory and cannot discharge a proof.
SHA-256 implementation and collision resistance bind source, generated artifacts, proof types and review records.
Hashed Python verifier, registered audit metaprogram, policy checks and negative-control runner implement the stated finite decision rule.
